item.title: CO-ATHLETES OF THE WEEK: Shaniece Brown, Evelyn Sheer, Hazleton Area
item.description: Senior Shaniece Brown and freshman Evelyn “The Pink Nightmare” Sheer became the first Hazleton Area girls to win individual District 2 wrestling championships. Both top seeds, Brown pinned all four of her opponents in the first period and Sheer floored both of her opponents after receiving a bye into the semifinals.
